summary: Tested L04 closure and L05 LN-050/051. BACKEND: test_l05_interval_form.py (4/4) and test_partial_loss_splits_child_at_partner (1/1) pass. New tests/test_l05_replacement_extra_t1.py: 9/11 pass. LN-050-T02 works (roll_ids required, returned roll rejected, unknown roll gives 400, lines = the replacement rolls, sales_returns.inspection_id unchanged). Interval counts are right (150->10, 151->11, 100->10, 300->20). Interval -1 gives 400. The 2 failures: point_value=5 and count=-2 return 200 because the rows are silently dropped. FRONTEND (desktop 1920 + mobile 390): L04 partial loss works end to end on cancelled MKO-00007. Invalid qty (50>roll, 0, -1, abc) shows mko-return-partial-error-1 and disables both mko-return-submit-1 and mko-loss-submit-1; qty = full roll is accepted as whole; '1,5' is accepted. The loss list appears (mko-loss-list-1), the ledger shows Masih di mitra 58,5 / Susut 1,5 / Seimbang, and in the DB the parent is subcon 42.28 and child RL-46130-2 has the same bucket_ref and is consumed. Mobile: mobile-open-makloon-orders under the Produk tab opens ?view=makloon-orders; MKO detail, ledger and return form are usable with no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390). L05 random check from scan (qc@): scanning fills in warehouse/count, label 'Periksa roll hasil scan', a roll from another entity is rejected with the 'cakupan' error, and a valid scan creates an SPK with exactly that roll. LN-051 modal: 10 chips by default, 11 at 165; add/remove rows works; 2 defects in the same interval are both stored (no merge); from/to 150-165 correct; points preview 9 mentions KLX-02 candidate; save stores inspect_form + grade_rule candidate_unvalidated. 390px layout fits. Replacement create modal: submit is disabled until rolls are entered, the returned roll shows an error, and success creates KSC/INS-00004 with RL-00002/RL-00003. Seed restore (restore_local_demo.sh) was started at the end.

minor.issue: normalize_interval_defects silently skips rows with point_value not in 1..4 or count<=0 (e.g. point 5, count -2) and returns 200. Defects the user entered are dropped with no error. Should return 400/422, like out-of-range interval does.

_split_partial_losses splits rolls before the later checks in run() (pending filter / empty rolls). If a later check raises, the child roll stays split. Harmless (same bucket, still subcon) but not atomic.

Replacement rolls are not checked for status (sold/held/consumed rolls are accepted). Passing both the id and the roll_no of the same roll gives a wrong 'tidak ditemukan' error because of the count comparison.

ui_bugs.issue: When reopened for a line that was already inspected, the modal resets ivRows=[] and inspectLen='' instead of loading line.defects / line.inspect_form. Saving then OVERWRITES the stored defects. Verified: re-saving blank via the same payload left defects=[] and points 0 (was 9). Data-loss risk.
After a loss, the banner reads 'bahan 58,5 yard (Rp 816.000) masih di ...'. valueLeft subtracts returns only, not losses. The step line above correctly shows 'nilai bahan Rp 795.600'.

If the user picks interval 10 (150-165) and then shortens the length to <=150, the select shows 'Interval…' but state keeps 10, so save fails with a backend 400. Clamp or reset intervals that fall outside the new length.

integration_issues.issue: The KLX-02 candidate note is only in the modal preview. After saving, the SPK detail row shows grade 'A → A' with no candidate/unvalidated badge, although grade_rule.status=candidate_unvalidated is stored.

issues: MobileOpsApp for the qc role ignores ?view=inspections and has no Inspeksi entry; it only works after mobile-force-desktop. Consider a mobile entry for inspections/random-check scan.
mobile-open-makloon-orders opens in 'Semua badan usaha' (read-only banner) mode, yet the return/loss form is still offered. Pass the entity or select it.

action_items: HIGH: InspectLineModal: prefill inspectLen/ivRows (and the quick counts) from line.inspect_form and line.defects when editing an already inspected line, so 'Ubah QC 4-point' does not wipe stored defects
Backend: reject invalid defect rows (point_value not in 1-4, count<=0) with 400 instead of silently dropping them
MakloonReturnMaterial: subtract losses (posted/auto value) from valueLeft in the banner
IntervalDefectGrid: reset/clamp row.interval when the length is reduced
Optional: show the candidate/KLX-02 badge on graded lines in the SPK detail; check replacement roll status
critical_code_review_comments: qc_inspection_service.normalize_interval_defects: silent `continue` on invalid pv/count hides user input errors
makloon_loss_service.record_loss: partial split happens mid-transaction before the final validation (not atomic)
inspection_service replacement: no status filter on replacement rolls; the id/roll_no mix makes the count check fragile
InspectLineModal useEffect resets defect state on open instead of hydrating it from the line
